title: (L1) Euclidean coefficient norm of a pulled-back covector: |β∘A|_E ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|_E
statement: Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ. Let A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} be a continuous linear map (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') with operator norm ‖A‖, and let β be a k-covector on ℝ^{N'} (β : Covector (Euclid N') k). Let β∘A := β.compContinuousLinearMap A, the k-covector (v_1, …, v_k) ↦ β(Av_1, …, Av_k) on ℝ^N. Then |β∘A|_E ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|_E, where |·|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm is the Euclidean coefficient norm on ℝ^N and on ℝ^{N'} respectively. The parent uses this with N = N' = P, A = L and k = n.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β
